tasks.label: Restart CerviScope app with footer attribution
tasks.command: $pids = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'python.exe'"; foreach ($p in $pids) { Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force }; $env:CERVISCOPE_USERNAME = 'operator'; $env:CERVISCOPE_PASSWORD = 'operator123'; $env:CERVISCOPE_SECRET_KEY = 'dev-secret-key-1234567890'; python app.py
